input: Sourcing a new own-brand frozen king prawn line for our Leeds-based supermarket chain, launching spring 2027: farmed Ecuadorian whiteleg (vannamei), raw peeled tail-on IQF 26/30 per lb, about 350 tonnes a year, continuous year-round supply, first shipment landed in the UK by 1 February 2027. Need ASC-certified farms, a BRCGS-certified plant, full pond-to-pack traceability and landed cost at or below £8.50/kg DDP UK. I want the most modern, high-output operation available, with the tightest biosecurity and process control and the best yield per hectare so volume is never a worry. Please sign a two-year supply contract with the best supplier.

experiences.name: Humber Kitchen Co. Plant-Based King Prawn Style Bites
experiences.description: Own-label frozen 'king prawn style' pieces made from konjac and pea protein, shaped and coloured to sit naturally in the seafood freezer aisle. Made in Grimsby with 300 t/yr capacity at a BRCGS AA-grade site, with an 8-week lead time for own-label artwork. Supplied frozen in bulk cases ready for retail packing.

experiences.name: Oroazul AquaTech Shrimp
experiences.description: Technology-led, high-output producer running its own hatchery, fully biosecure El Oro grow-out sites and a BRCGS plant in Machala. 500 t/yr at 26/30, raw PTO IQF vannamei, ASC-certified, traced pond to carton, year-round to UK and EU retailers. Grow-out: super-intensive HDPE-lined ponds stocked at 180 postlarvae per m²; bare liner bottom with no sediment or substrate. Postlarvae come from non-ablated broodstock. Harvested shrimp are electrically stunned at pond-side before ice chilling. Reefers via Guayaquil to Felixstowe, about 28 days; DDP UK from January 2027; two-year terms.

experiences.name: Manglar Alto Seafood Exports
experiences.description: Established contracted-farm programme in Guayas and El Oro: biosecure sites, continuous aeration. Two BRCGS plants in Durán secure 350+ t/yr at 26/30, raw PTO IQF vannamei, ASC-certified, year-round. Farms stock earthen ponds at no more than 20 postlarvae per m², natural sediment bottom; stocking density and dissolved oxygen are logged daily and checked at the annual farm audit. Postlarvae come from non-ablated broodstock. Harvested shrimp are electrically stunned at pond-side before ice chilling. Farm lot codes on every master carton give full traceability; DDP UK from January 2027; two-year terms.

experiences.name: Wrekin Flexipack Recyclable Prawn Pouches
experiences.description: Resealable mono-PP stand-up pouches printed with your own-brand artwork, built for frozen king prawn packs and freezer handling. Printed in Telford and eligible for the OPRL 'recycle' label. Six-week print lead time, delivered on pallets to any UK or overseas packer.

experiences.name: Nexmar Shrimp Export Programme
experiences.description: Technology-led, high-output programme built on contracted farms in Guayas and Santa Elena with fully biosecure indoor grow-out. Two BRCGS plants in Durán secure 350+ t/yr at 26/30, raw PTO IQF vannamei, ASC-certified, year-round. Grow-out: covered biofloc raceways stocked at 250–300 postlarvae per m²; bare concrete floor with no sediment or substrate. Postlarvae come from non-ablated broodstock. Harvested shrimp are electrically stunned at pond-side before ice chilling. Farm lot codes on every master carton give full traceability; DDP UK from January 2027; two-year terms.

experiences.name: Tierra Roja Camaronera
experiences.description: Established integrated producer: own hatchery, biosecure El Oro grow-out and BRCGS-certified plant near Machala. 450 t/yr at 26/30, raw PTO IQF vannamei from ASC-certified farms, lot-traced from pond to packing, supplying UK and EU retailers year-round. Grow-out: earthen ponds stocked at 12–15 postlarvae per m²; natural sediment bottom; dissolved oxygen kept above 4 mg/L with continuous aeration. Postlarvae come from non-ablated broodstock. Harvested shrimp are electrically stunned at pond-side before ice chilling. Reefers via Guayaquil to Southampton, about 27 days; DDP UK from January 2027; two-year terms.

experiences.name: Charnwood Sauce Co. Garlic, Chilli & Lemon Sachets
experiences.description: Plant-based garlic, chilli and lemon marinade sachets on a rapeseed-oil base, made to be co-packed into a cook-in king prawn kit. Made in Leicestershire with an 18-month ambient shelf life, supplied in cartons of 2,000 sachets.
